requirement: On Linux the desktop app keeps Chromium's cookie key in the basic store, so no keyring dialog blocks the first window; macOS and Windows keep their OS store

oracle.ref: PR #1148 (fix); fix evidence: Ubuntu 24.04 GNOME auto-login, 0.4.0/0.5.0: 'Choose password for new keyring' at first launch, blank window (test/desktop-0-5-0-winlinux-smoke, tasks/evidence/desktop-onboard/2026-10-11-winlinux-smoke/linux/L01, L21, L02)
oracle.invariant: S1: passwordStoreSwitch returns 'basic' for platform linux with no --password-store on the command line. S1: it returns null for darwin and win32. S1: it returns null on linux when the launch already names --password-store. S1: main.js applies it before app.whenReady and after refuseDebugSwitches; debugGuardFirst(main.js) is still true.
